aircraft._commentFlaps: Aircraft-specific flap detents are not defined: airbus-base intentionally does not assert shared Airbus flap notches. Add A330-specific detents only with documented sources and in-simulator verification.

grades._comment: Provisional wide-body Airbus landing bands pending MSFS 2024 A330-family verification.

lvars._comment: This profile uses documented standard SimVars only. It subscribes to zero iniBuilds-specific LVARs or Input Events.

controls._comment: The exact-profile adapter is readback-only. Live testing showed that the unverified standard key-event candidates do not control the iniBuilds A330 cockpit selectors, and iniBuilds has not published a verified external Input Event or LVAR write contract. All writes remain unavailable pending documented, variant-specific in-simulator verification.

meta.notes: Dedicated exact-profile aircraft page for the included MSFS 2024 Airbus A330-200, A330-300, and A330-300P2F family. The trusted adapter exposes 45 standard-SimVar logical fields and no active write actions. It has zero custom LVAR subscriptions and remains intentionally separate from the Headwind A330-900neo. A330 write controls remain unavailable pending documented, variant-specific in-simulator verification.

sources.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 FAQ - aircraft matrix
sources.notes: Lists Airbus A330 (-200, -300, 300P2F) as included with Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Standard, Deluxe, Premium Deluxe, and Aviator editions.

sources.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator - Aircraft Manuals
sources.notes: Provides an Airbus A330 Version 1 manual from iniBuilds, supporting product identity and a source-backed partial profile. The page does not publish an external telemetry/control variable map.

sources.name: MSFS 2024 Avionics Framework - SimVars
sources.notes: Documents standard MSFS SimVars/A-vars as queryable simulator state. The trusted A330 adapter exposes only an explicit allowlist already normalized by Flight Fabric and activates no aircraft-specific L: or B: variables.

sources.name: MSFS 2024 Avionics Framework - Key Events
sources.notes: Documents the simulator key-event transport used by this exact-profile adapter. The active event IDs and their parameters are enumerated by the category-specific Microsoft SDK sources below.

sources.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 SDK - Aircraft Autopilot and Flight Assist Events
sources.notes: Source for every active flight-guidance event: AUTOPILOT_OFF, AUTOPILOT_ON, TOGGLE_FLIGHT_DIRECTOR, AUTO_THROTTLE_ARM, AP_AIRSPEED_OFF, AP_AIRSPEED_ON, AP_HDG_HOLD_OFF, AP_HDG_HOLD_ON, AP_ALT_HOLD_OFF, AP_ALT_HOLD_ON, AP_VS_OFF, AP_VS_ON, AP_NAV1_HOLD_OFF, AP_NAV1_HOLD_ON, AP_APR_HOLD_OFF, AP_APR_HOLD_ON, FLIGHT_LEVEL_CHANGE_OFF, FLIGHT_LEVEL_CHANGE_ON, AP_SPD_VAR_SET, HEADING_BUG_SET, AP_ALT_VAR_SET_ENGLISH, and AP_VS_VAR_SET_ENGLISH. These are standard simulator events, not an A330-specific AP1/AP2 or Airbus managed/selected FCU contract.

sources.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 SDK - Aircraft Electrical Events
sources.notes: Source for every active exterior-light event: STROBES_SET, BEACON_LIGHTS_SET, NAV_LIGHTS_SET, LOGO_LIGHTS_SET, WING_LIGHTS_SET, LANDING_LIGHTS_SET, and TAXI_LIGHTS_SET. Each uses a fixed 0/1 target and confirms the corresponding standard light-output SimVar; no A330 selector-position semantics are inferred.

sources.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 SDK - Aircraft Flight Control Events
sources.notes: Source for every active flap and spoiler event: FLAPS_DECR, FLAPS_INCR, SPOILERS_ARM_OFF, SPOILERS_ARM_ON, and SPOILERS_SET. The numeric spoiler target is bounded to the SDK's 0..16383 event range and confirmed through normalized standard spoiler-handle readback.

sources.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 SDK - Aircraft General Systems Events
sources.notes: Source for every active gear and parking-brake event: GEAR_UP, GEAR_DOWN, and PARKING_BRAKE_SET. Flight Fabric exposes fixed semantic targets only and confirms the newer standard handle/state readback.

knownIssues: Exact MSFS 2024 aircraft title strings for each A330 variant remain unverified in-sim.
The 45 standard-SimVar fields remain monitoring-only. Live testing showed that the unverified standard-event candidates do not control the custom A330 cockpit selectors.

AP1/AP2, Airbus managed/selected FCU push-pull, EXPED, exact A330 light-selector positions, and all other write controls remain unavailable without a vendor-documented and in-simulator-verified Input Event or LVAR contract.

The cited public sources do not define a complete A330-specific LVAR, B-var, or InputEvent integration map. The adapter subscribes to zero custom variables and does not activate candidate INI_* names from package snapshots or community presets.
Standard light readback is retained for monitoring but does not authorize write controls or identify every multi-position cockpit selector state.
Flap detents are intentionally absent; do not inherit or reintroduce broad Airbus base detents without A330-specific evidence.
This profile intentionally does not cover the Headwind A330-900neo, which has its own profile.
